run_SampleEmbeddingModule: run the SampleEmbeddingModule to sample and concatenate embeddings from multiple embedded files into a training sample
create_SampleEmbeddingModuleConfig: create a SampleEmbeddingModuleConfig dataclass with language, embedded files, output directory, and sample size settings
sample_single_embedding: sample a subset of embeddings from a single embedded file and save to an output numpy file
review_SampleEmbeddingModule_run: review the SampleEmbeddingModule run method that parallelizes sampling across shards using joblib and concatenates results
refactor_SampleEmbeddingModule_shard_log: refactor the SampleEmbeddingModule shard sample size calculation to handle edge cases where the last shard is smaller than sample size
